title: NASA people study the phenomenon and travel with him

tellings.quote: Yeah. We love them. And uh but there are a lot of other NASA guys that I'm currently talking with.

plain: People from NASA study what happens around him and travel with him, says Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has drawn UFO sightings since 2007. He tells Michels he is fond of the ones he already knows, among them a man named Timothy Taylor, and that "there are a lot of other NASA guys that I'm currently talking with." If true, it would mean people inside NASA are quietly taking his experiences seriously.
